title: Dispatch: repair Sol S1 (registry evidence citations) and S2 (remaining historical banners) for PR #698 (attempt 1)
description:

S1: correct the new statusReasoning strings in docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json so that each one names the CURRENT representation and evidence that actually tests the claimed property.
- source-authority-fable-f5 must cite packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseDocumentTables.test.ts, the Scrying pins and the literal header-span invariant. It must not cite fieldProvenanceGate.test.ts.
- locator-completeness, source-provenance-fields and container-continuation must cite recordLocatorCompleteness.test.ts. Find its real path. Cite enrichProvenance or committed-pack evidence only where it really tests the property. The representation is records.json provenance.fieldLocators plus the source-region ledger, not field-provenance.json.
- source-authority-sol-cap-008: the Bag of Beans branch is mechanics.effects[id=c2-residual-dump-beans-explosion].successfulSaveDamage = 'half'. Verify the exact path in the current pack.
- half-damage-branches: limit the wording to the representation cases the census actually distinguishes (typed-save damageOnSuccess, magic-item-effect successfulSaveDamage, and whatever else the census lists). Read halfDamageSuccessBranches.test.ts.
For every citation, verify by mutating it in memory or by reading the assertion that the cited test fails on the bad state. Use full repository-rooted paths for every cited file; a sibling PR's evidence gate rejects ambiguous basenames.

S2: finish the deliverable-B banner sweep across every top-level file in docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/ outside thaw-notes/. Read each file. Every one that makes a completeness, exhaustive-ownership, 'Coverage: COMPLETE', 'Do not repeat this audit', final-readiness, sign-off or re-freeze claim gets the same historical-scope banner form as README.md:
- its own date and snapshot;
- ADR 0020 withdrawal;
- section 5.9;
- a pointer to the candidate record and the later gates.
Sol names, at minimum:

- 2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-rule-classification.md

- 2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-magic-item-state-contract-design.md

Check the rest too (the 18-7-9 designs, the 18-8-7 note, finding-registry.md, known-source-typos.md, the equipment inventory .md and .json). List each file you bannered or deliberately left unbannered, with a reason. Historical bodies stay byte-for-byte. Update the 19.6.1 thaw note's file list.

Do not touch line 861 (row engine-capability-ownership) of the registry; PR #697 edits it.

Finish:
- Run `npm run verify:worktree` before committing, and commit only on success.
- Record the per-row evidence and the banner list with `bd update eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1.3 --append-notes`, then `bd close eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1.3`.
- Do not push, open a PR or merge.
